market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Maine has a history of ticket-splitting and electing moderate Republicans like Susan Collins, who is the likely 2026 nominee. Even in a Democratic-leaning state, Collins outperformed in 2020 and would be a heavy favorite if she runs. The market's 23.5% implies Collins has only a ~1-in-4 chance, which seems far too low given her incumbency and cross-party appeal. The true probability is around 65%, creating a large edge.
evidence_points: Susan Collins won her last Senate race in 2020 with 51% of the vote, outperforming Donald Trump's 44% in the state.
Maine has voted for Republican senators in every election since 1972 except for a brief period in the 1980s, demonstrating durable GOP strength in Senate contests.
No strong Democratic challenger has emerged, and the 2026 midterm environment under a Democratic president historically favors the opposition party.
sources_consulted: 2020 Maine Senate election results (Collins vs Gideon)
